$comment: Single source of truth for cross-layer numeric constants. Every value here is referenced by `src/tests/contracts.infra.test.ts` which grep-asserts the value appears in the listed consumer files. Drift between spec/SQL/Zod/migration is now a CI failure, not a Phase-N holistic review finding. See docs/specs/00_engineering_standards.md §11 + the contracts.infra.test.ts header for the consumer mapping rules.

zoning.$comment: Spec 65 enrich-parcels. ambiguous_dominant_share_max: a parcel whose dominant base-zone intersection share is below this is flagged zoning_is_ambiguous. Consumer: scripts/lib/zoning-precedence.js AMBIGUOUS_DOMINANT_SHARE_MAX (pinned by contracts.infra.test.ts).
zoning.$comment_fh12: Spec 66 enrich-permits F-H12 gates. FAIL when construction-permit / CoA zoning_class coverage drops below these. Spike-calibrated (live: permits 84.2%, coa 84.4% — §8d's aspirational 99/95 is unachievable; ~84% ceiling = 5.5% no-link + ~10% gap-parcel). Catches regression, not an aspirational target. Consumer: scripts/enrich-permits.js (pinned by contracts.infra.test.ts).

build_norms.$comment: Spec 78 Phase 1 — neighbourhood_build_norms (compute-build-norms.js). Structural + tunable constants for the realized build/reno norms. Consumer: scripts/lib/build-norms.js (pinned by contracts.infra.test.ts). window_years: the rolling permit window. min_sample_default: < this in a neighbourhood → low_sample → optimal-config uses citywide fallback. over_capture_clamp: realized/max-build ratios above this are massing over-capture, excluded from the build-ratio percentile. build_ratio_null_rate_warn: audit WARN when >this fraction of neighbourhoods have no build_ratio.

optimal_config.$comment: Spec 78 Phase 2 — optimal-lot-configuration engine (scripts/lib/optimal-config.js). Toronto Zoning By-law 569-2013 Ch.150.7 (garden/laneway suites) in-force consolidation constants, verified 2026-06-26 vs toronto.ca/zoning. Operator-tunable where the by-law may shift (a 2025 DRAFT proposes removing the 40% rear-yard term). Consumer: scripts/lib/optimal-config.js (pinned by contracts.infra.test.ts); Phase 3 enrich-parcels SQL will add itself as a consumer.

parcel_cost_model.$comment: Spec 88 — parcel renovation cost model. SEED-MIGRATION LITERAL LOCK: every rate here is the canonical external-industry $/m² ($/ft² × 10.764) documented in Spec 88 §3 and SEEDED by migrations/205_archetype_cost_rates.sql. The lock pins the migration seed literal against this JSON so a re-seed can't silently diverge from the §3 design table. These are admin-TUNABLE at runtime (archetype_cost_rates table, Spec 86) — the lock governs the seed, not runtime values. solar_adj_factor = SOLAR cost_adjustment_factor (usable-roof fraction, §2). Consumer for all rows: migrations/205_archetype_cost_rates.sql (pinned by contracts.infra.test.ts).

p16_gate.$comment: Spec 80 §5.C / P16-D3 [FAB3] — the 16B lean-complement GO/NO-GO gate thresholds (scored on the held-out half of the 122-permit inspection corpus). recall_floor: recovering toward the 62.6% pre-P13-3 anchor; prec_floor: 10 pts off the 65.8% evidence baseline (a union necessarily dips precision); mean_lo/mean_hi: the target attached-trades/permit band (evidence-only is 6.0, pre-P13-3 16.6 is the inflation avoided). Consumer: scripts/analysis/p14-trade-attachment-evaluation.js (gateThresholds). 2026-07-10 GO: hold-out recall 61.4% / prec(insp) 70.5% / mean 10.2.
